A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
leaf spectral indices can be used for rapid assessment of water status and photosynthetic limitations in olive trees during water-stress and recovery.
leaf reflectance indices are useful to assess the water status of olive trees during drought and re-watering, and to identify the limitations to photosynthesis under water-stress.
PRI and WI were the best indicators of the physiological state of olive leaves during water-stress, and they could be used as early indicators of water stress.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PRI is a sensitive indicator of water stress and photosynthetic limitations in oleander.
PRI can be used as a proxy for carotenoid content and leaf conductance to water vapour, whereas WI can be used to monitor water stress and transpiration in olive leaves.
PRI and WI are very sensitive to physiological changes in the olive tree and could be used as a fast and nondestructive tool to detect physiological changes in olive trees under drought and recovery.
